# EchoNous

> > AI-powered point-of-care ultrasound technology bringing cart-quality imaging to handheld devices for clinical decision support across specialties.

EchoNous develops Kosmos, an FDA-cleared portable POCUS platform with integrated AI algorithms for cardiac, bladder, and trauma imaging. The company serves emergency medicine, critical care, cardiology, and other specialties with affordable, handheld ultrasound solutions.

## Key Topics

- Kosmos (AI-driven POCUS device)
- Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS)
- Portable Ultrasound
- AI Imaging & Clinical Decision Support
- Cardiac Imaging
- Bladder Scanning
- Vascular Access Guidance
- Procedural Guidance
- FAST Exam
- Musculoskeletal (MSK) Ultrasound
- API & SDK Integration
- Multi-Platform Compatibility
- FDA-Cleared Devices

## Kosmos Product Suite

- [Kosmos AI-driven POCUS device](https://echonous.com/product/kosmos-ultraportable-ultrasound): Kosmos: AI-enhanced handheld POCUS device combining cart-quality with affordability.
- [AI POCUS](https://echonous.com/product/kosmos-ai): Kosmos AI features deep learning algorithms for cardiac, bladder, and FAST exams.
- [Next Generation Bladder Volume Solution: Kosmos Bladder](https://echonous.com/kosmos-bladder): Kosmos Bladder: accurate, reliable, affordable bladder volume scanning solution.
- [OB/GYN & Vascular Tools | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/kosmos-ob-gyn-vascular-expansion): Kosmos expands with FDA-cleared OB/GYN and vascular tools for billable ultrasound exams.
- [Kosmos Ultrasound Software Solutions | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/product/software-solutions): Kosmos software integrates with existing ultrasound systems for enhanced workflow.
- [Kosmos: Multi-Platform Advanced Capabilities](https://echonous.com/product/device-compatibility): Kosmos compatibility across iOS, Android, and proprietary Bridge platform.

## Clinical Applications by Specialty

- [POCUS for Emergency Medicine | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/emergency-medicine): Kosmos improves diagnostic accuracy and workflow in emergency departments.
- [POCUS in Critical Care | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/critical-care): Kosmos POCUS enhances diagnostic capabilities in ICU and critical care settings.
- [POCUS in Cardiology | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/cardiology): Kosmos provides cart-based cardiac imaging in portable handheld device.
- [Ultrasound in Anesthesiology | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/anesthesiology): Kosmos POCUS for anesthesiology with vascular access and nerve block guidance.
- [Kosmos for Musculoskeletal (MSK) Ultrasound](https://echonous.com/specialty/musculoskeletal-msk-ultrasound): Kosmos enables real-time, cost-effective MSK imaging and guided injections.
- [POCUS in Nephrology | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/nephrology): Kosmos POCUS improves nephrology workflow with renal and cardiac imaging.
- [AI POCUS in Hospital Medicine](https://echonous.com/specialty/hospital-medicine): Kosmos provides portable POCUS for hospital medicine at fraction of cart cost.
- [POCUS for Family Medicine & Primary Care | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/primary-care): Kosmos AI enhances patient care and workflow for primary care providers.
- [Ultrasound for Nurses | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/nursing): Kosmos enables nurses to perform bladder volumes and vascular access guidance.
- [Kosmos for Global Health | EchoNous](https://echonous.com/specialty/global-health): Kosmos portable ultrasound for global health initiatives and remote areas.
